name: Finite direct-sample contraction branch certificate

statement.note_ascii: a finite raw-data uncertainty box certifies its own local inverse branch when a fixed preconditioner, a branch-wide Jacobian-defect bound below one, and the Banach self-map inequality are independently certified

definitions.S: finite-dimensional square direct sample/observation map on the declared local branch
definitions.delta: raw-data center discrepancy plus certified sensor radius plus certified forward-model radius

parents.evidence: adds a sufficient raw-data self-map condition so branch membership need not be supplied as an external boolean
isolates the finite theorem needed to convert a direct sample-map q<1 certificate into raw-data branch capture and rho_N

claim_boundary: Finite local theorem only. It does not construct q, A, the forward-model radius, or a sensor model; it does not exclude additional roots outside the declared branch. No arbitrary-N, continuum, Navier-Stokes regularity, physical validation, or Clay conclusion follows automatically. No completed-infinity premise is used.
